title.en: Proportional reasoning 2: maps, multi-term ratios and inverse proportion

text.en: Viswanath mixes 6 cups of rice with 3 cups of urad dal and Puneet mixes 4 cups with 2 cups. Will their idlis taste the same?

Two ratios a : b and c : d are proportional if a × d = b × c; here 6 × 2 = 3 × 4, so the idlis taste alike.
Maps give a Representative Fraction (RF) like 1 : 60,00,000, meaning 1 unit on the map is 60,00,000 of the same unit on the ground.
With RF 1 : 60,00,000, a 5 cm line on the map stands for 3,00,00,000 cm, which is 300 km.
Ratios can have more than two terms, like 2 : 3 : 5 for three ingredients, and they work the same way.
To divide a whole in a ratio, add the terms to get the total parts, find one part, then multiply.
A pie chart is a circle divided in a ratio: each slice angle equals its fraction × 360°.
In direct proportion, when one quantity doubles the other doubles, and the ratio y/x stays the same.
In inverse proportion, when one quantity doubles the other halves, and the product x × y stays the same.
For example, if 6 workers finish a job in 10 days, 12 workers need 5 days because 6 × 10 = 12 × 5.
Always decide whether more of one means more or less of the other before choosing direct or inverse.
Two ratios a : b and c : d are proportional if a × d = b × c; here 6 × 2 = 3 × 4, so the idlis taste alike.

problem.en: 6 workers can paint a wall in 10 days. How long will 15 workers take?

text.en: More workers means fewer days, so this is inverse proportion.

prompt.en: How do you decide direct or inverse proportion?

requiredIdeas.en: Check what happens when one quantity doubles.
If the other doubles, it is direct.
If it halves, it is inverse.

commonMisconceptions.en: In inverse proportion the ratio is constant.

points.en: a : b = c : d when a × d = b × c.
RF on a map is map distance to ground distance.
Inverse proportion keeps the product constant; direct keeps the ratio constant.
